verdict.rationale: ADK documents eval test files that serve 'as a form of unit testing' and tool-trajectory metrics, but these evaluate real agent-model interactions. Nothing in the evidence shows a mock or fake model, stubbed tools, or a test harness for isolating agents from live LLM calls. Evaluation runs and a general claim of 'testability' are adjacent features, not the mocked-model and mocked-tool unit testing this story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, I can unit-test agents with mocked models and tools
